"IMPOSTER — NEXT DEVELOPMENT UPDATE

I want to make a focused improvement to my existing Imposter party game.

IMPORTANT: Do not rebuild the game. Do not redesign everything. Preserve the existing working features, game logic, and cream-and-lime-green visual identity.

I want to develop slowly, one feature at a time.

FIRST: REMOVE THESE FEATURES FROM THE CURRENT ROADMAP

Do not implement these features yet:

- Hindi language support.
- Additional language support.
- Custom word packs.
- QR code word sharing.
- Player avatars.

Keep the current player setup and English word categories.

Do not spend development time on these postponed features.

FEATURE 1: PARTY MATCH HISTORY AND STATISTICS

Add a persistent party statistics system.

The game should allow users to create a party consisting of a group of named players.

Example:

Party name: My Friends

Players:

- Alex
- Jordan
- Taylor
- Miz
- Sam
- Chris

When this group plays multiple matches, automatically track their results.

Statistics to track

For every player, record:

1. Total matches played.
2. Total matches won.
3. Number of times selected as Imposter.
4. Number of wins as Imposter.
5. Number of times caught as Imposter.
6. Number of normal-player wins.

Leaderboards

Create a party statistics screen containing:

- Most matches won.
- Most frequent Imposter.
- Most successful Imposter.
- Most frequently caught Imposter.
- Overall player leaderboard.

Show player names, statistics, and rankings in a clean interface.

Persistence

Statistics must remain saved when:

- A new round starts.
- The application is closed.
- The application is reopened.

Use reliable local storage appropriate to the existing application architecture.

Party management

Allow users to:

- Create a new party.
- Reuse an existing party.
- View party match history.
- View individual player statistics.
- Reset party statistics after confirmation.
- Start a fresh party without mixing its statistics with another party.

Keep the system simple.

Do not introduce online accounts or cloud multiplayer.

Important scoring rules

- Award points only after a completed match.
- Do not award points twice for the same match.
- Correctly handle multiple Imposters.
- Attribute wins to the correct winning team.
- Do not count incomplete or abandoned rounds as completed matches.

FEATURE 2: IMPOSTER WORD HINT SETTING

Add a toggle to the game setup screen.

Setting label:

\"Give Imposters word hints?\"

Description:

\"Give Imposters a small hint about the secret word to make the game easier for them.\"

When OFF:

- Imposters receive no hints.
- Existing gameplay remains unchanged.

When ON:

- Each Imposter receives a private, carefully generated hint.
- Hints must be relevant to the secret word.
- Hints must not reveal the actual secret word.
- Hints should be vague enough to preserve the challenge.
- All Imposters should receive the same hint unless the game mode requires otherwise.

Example:

Secret word: Strawberry.

Imposter hint: \"It's a fruit.\"

The normal players should continue seeing the actual secret word.

The Imposter should see only their assigned hint, never the actual word.

Show this hint privately during the role reveal.

Make sure this setting works with multiple Imposters.

FEATURE 3: OPTIONAL TYPED CLUE ROUND

The existing game has a clue-entry screen.

It displays:
\"One clue. Keep it clever.\"

It asks each player to enter a one-word clue before voting.

I want this feature to become optional.

Add a setup toggle:

\"Enable typed clue round?\"

Description:

\"Players enter a clue on their turn before voting.\"

When ON:

- Preserve the current clue-entry screen.
- Each player submits one clue.
- Display submitted clues.
- Continue to discussion and voting as usual.

When OFF:

- Skip the entire typed clue-entry phase.
- Do not display the clue input.
- Do not require clue submissions.
- Proceed directly to the discussion phase and then voting.
- Preserve the existing voting system.
- Preserve all existing winning conditions.

IMPORTANT:

Disabling typed clues must never disable voting.

Do not remove the existing clue feature. Make it optional.

FEATURE 4: SETUP SCREEN DESIGN

Place both new gameplay settings on the existing setup screen:

1. Give Imposters word hints?
2. Enable typed clue round?

Use attractive, compact toggle controls matching the existing design.

Requirements:

- Clearly display ON and OFF states.
- Explain each setting briefly.
- Save the settings locally.
- Preserve the selected settings when starting another round.
- Allow users to change them before starting a new game.

Do not overcrowd the setup screen.

DEVELOPMENT APPROACH

Before changing anything:

1. Inspect the current project.
2. Understand the existing player management.
3. Understand how match results are calculated.
4. Understand the current clue phase.
5. Understand how secret roles and words are distributed.
6. Identify the existing persistence mechanism.

Then implement these features without breaking the existing functionality.

Implement in this order:

PHASE 1: Both setup toggles and their actual gameplay behavior.

PHASE 2: Persistent party statistics and match history.

PHASE 3: Test everything.

Do not create visual-only controls.

Every toggle must actually change the gameplay.

Every statistic must come from real completed matches.

Test both ON and OFF states.

Test multiple Imposters.

Test restarting the application.

Test that the statistics do not get mixed between different parties.

Do not add the postponed features.

FINAL GOAL:

Make the existing Imposter game more customizable and replayable while keeping it simple, polished, reliable, and easy to play with friends using one shared phone.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Complete the existing Imposter party game’s optional hints and typed clues, plus locally persistent party statistics and match history, without rebuilding it.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing game flow, cream-and-lime-green identity, player setup, English categories, and voting/win conditions.
- Persist settings locally; hints must not reveal the secret word to Imposters.
- Count completed matches once and correctly attribute team wins with multiple Imposters.
- Support named, reusable parties with isolated players, scores, stats, and history; show party and individual stats; confirm resets.
- Do not add other languages, custom word packs, QR word sharing, or player avatars.

## Decisions
- Use `localStorage` and `finishGame()` as the match scoring point.
- Store party data separately per party; keep settings shared locally.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added party creation/switching, locally persistent hint and clue toggles, Imposter hints, typed clue flow, scoring/history, stats view, and confirmed party reset.
- Removed custom word pack controls/use and deleted the stale `openPackModal()` function.
- New parties now initialize without copying the current party’s players.
- Added responsive party and stats/history styles.
- `node --check app.js` and `git diff --check` pass; Chromium headless loaded `index.html` and rendered the setup screen.

### Active
- Verify party isolation and persistence, clue/hint toggles, multiple-Imposter scoring, stats/history, and reset confirmation through gameplay/browser testing.

### Blocked
- Browser interaction tests have not been performed; available Chromium check only dumped the initial setup DOM.

## Next Move
1. Run browser interaction tests for gameplay, party switching/isolation, scoring, stats/history, reset, and persistence across reloads.
2. Fix any issues revealed by those tests.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Game logic, settings, party persistence, hints/clues, scoring, and stats/history rendering.
- `styles.css`: Existing styles plus new party and stats/history styling.
- `index.html`: App shell and asset loading.

## Important Context
- `app.js` and `styles.css` have uncommitted changes.

- Complete the existing Imposter party game’s optional hints and typed clues, plus locally persistent party statistics and match history, without rebuilding it.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing game flow, cream-and-lime-green identity, player setup, English categories, and voting/win conditions.

- Use `localStorage` and `finishGame()` as the match scoring point.

Do not mix these two flows.

For the next round, randomly select a new starting player.

IMPOSTER SCREEN

Do not reveal the secret word.

Do not reveal the secret word's category.

"YOU ARE THE IMPOSTER"

If the optional Imposter word hint setting is enabled, show the assigned hint according to its existing behavior.

Do not create fake buttons or visual-only screens.

Implement actual working functionality.

Keep the game simple, smooth, private, and enjoyable for people playing together using one shared phone.
